items.name: yorha-demo
items.title: YorhaDemo settings page
items.description: Route page for a settings screen: AppShell frame, PageHeader, SystemMenuLayout with a TextField and a reset Dialog. Copy the page to app/routes/yorha-demo.tsx in a react-router app and install the listed items first.
items.docs: Unofficial fan project, not affiliated with Square Enix or PlatinumGames. Inspired by the YoRHa UI aesthetic; no original fonts, logos or assets are included.
